points: Led backend work on document information extraction and OCR, integrating third-party AI services for classification, tagging and metadata extraction.
Built the backend for AI document chat and smart search across an organisation's documents, with confidence-scored answers.
Built finance alerts (invoices, purchase orders, shipping orders) with risk priority and an audit workflow, plus an analytics hub for KPIs, forecasting and reports.
Built workflow modules (Forms, Flow Hub, Calendar Hub) and Dashboard Pilot, a self-service dashboard builder with an AI co-pilot.
Contributed to platform security, performance, testing and deployment documentation as part of the development team.
Implemented and tested open-source OCR, improving output readability, run-time, resource usage and structure.
Classified and tagged documents with zero-shot classification and tag-generation models from Hugging Face.
Extracted document metadata (e.g. author, date) with named entity recognition.
Assembled Kaggle test datasets to measure model accuracy, run-time and resource usage.
Forecast and planned production and sales from prior-year trends and seasonality.
Built a semi-automated Google Sheets + Power BI dashboard shared with logistics, production and fulfilment, reducing repetitive manual work.
Analysed raw-material purchases, shipping costs and supply/demand across peak and off-peak seasons in R.
Prepared and presented the department's monthly town-hall reports.
